newsitem.title: USA: Cinema Ride retains investment banker.
newsitem.headline: Cinema Ride retains investment banker.

text.p: Cinema Ride Inc said Tuesday it has retained the investment banking firm of L.H. Friend, Weinross, Frankson & Presson Inc.

The company said in a statement its investment banker will offer strategic advice and help the company pursue potential sources of capital, such as a secondary offering, corporate partnership or joint venture, to fund the development of its fourth and subsequent Cinema Ride locations.
Cinema Ride has three thrill ride facilities featuring the first and only 3-D simulator. They are located in Las Vegas, Edmonton, Alberta, and Times Square in New York City.
